note: IsaacLab physics simulation with each OBJ part approximated as its posed axis-aligned bounding-box cuboid. Fixed parts are static colliders; the moving part is released as a dynamic rigid body. This measures physical placement/release stability, not full mesh connectors or robot insertion.
axis_mapping: dataset XYZ (Y-up) -> Isaac XYZ as [data_x, data_z, data_y]
